Plot source scientific Kantz parameter sensitivity

etr_plot_kantz_sensitivity.Rd

Present frozen eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 scientific plotting geometry while retaining original native R numeric calculations, data, graphics and estimator semantics.

Usage

etr_plot_kantz_sensitivity(result, parameter, response = "exponent", filters = NULL,
  strict_source_record = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

result

Native precomputed Kantz parameter sensitivity result with finite declared source table.

parameter

Exact numerical parameter varied in a unique source sensitivity slice.

response

One of the supported exponent, fit quality or reference-count measures.

filters

Optional named exact values holding other sensitivity parameters fixed.

strict_source_record

If TRUE return a typed native R record of the frozen Python scientific Matplotlib artists instead of the original numeric table.

...

Legacy base R plotting options.

Value

Original numerical Kantz sensitivity slice returned invisibly by default; strict mode gives the original o-marker line, source labels, physical exponent unit, and dashed/dotted zero reference for the exponent response. It does not return a Python Axes object.

Details

Strict artist records cover a bounded native source-scientific geometry domain. No actual Python Matplotlib Axes, Python dataclass/pandas protocol or exception-class identity, independent complete-domain certification, or pixel-level rendering equivalence is asserted.
